typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		CU_SF as string,
		VarianceNotes as string,
		InsertTs as string,
		dc as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		CU_SF as string,
		VarianceNotes as string,
		InsertTs as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		DC as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CU_SF,
		VarianceNotes,
		InsertTs,
		DC = dc),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
